test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the word pair in which the words are related in the same way as the words are related in the following pair.

Bhutan ∶ Thimphu
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Bhutan ∶ Thimphu → Thimphu is the capital city of Bhutan.

Similarly,

Pakistan ∶ Islamabad → Islamabad is the capital city of Pakistan.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
